requirements.text: Work collaboratively with a cross-functional team of engineers, analysts and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into scalable end-to-end software solutions
Build, and maintain highly responsive and intuitive user interfaces and applications using modern JavaScript and ReactJS

Design, implement, and maintain comprehensive test automation suites (unit, integration, and end-to-end) using tools such as Playwright, PyTest and Jest to ensure high code quality and software reliability
Drive DevOps best practices by building and managing robust CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI) for automated testing and continuous deployment
Provision, manage, and monitor cloud infrastructure (AWS) utilizing containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or CloudFormation
Participate in the full software development lifecycle within an Agile environment, including system design, coding, code reviews, and architecture planning
5+ years of software engineering experience focused on building, and supporting scalable production web applications
Effective use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.) to enhance coding efficiency, testing, and documentation
Proficiency in backend development using Python (experience with frameworks like FastAPI, Flask, or Django)
Proficiency in frontend development using JavaScript (ES6+) and ReactJS
Experience writing automated tests and working with modern testing frameworks for both front-end and back-end
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a commitment to writing clean, maintainable, and testable code
Experience building data-intensive applications that manipulate and visualize complex datasets
Hands-on experience providing operational support for production applications, including system monitoring, incident response, and infrastructure troubleshooting
Experience designing and developing robust end-to-end automated test frameworks to ensure quality and reliability across complex production web applications
Proficiency in SQL for writing complex queries, and optimizing database performance (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL)
Knowledge of industry data standards and regulatory compliance (e.g., 21 CFR Part 11, GxPand HIPAA/GDPR)
